expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in almost no contrast. The promo code — the key information — is effectively illegible.

Favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the first card has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second card has a dark circular background with a white heart.

Thumbnails in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are visually inconsistent — the first card ('Green Bowl Poké') uses a light grey/white background while the others use dark, blurred photo-style backgrounds, making the row look unfinished.
The promo banner's subtext runs very close to the right edge of the banner and its decorative circle overlaps the text area, adding to the readability problem.
